provenance: Repo-local descriptor (the publisher's own repo). Backends and context come from the repo's litertlm_manifest.json (cpu and gpu, cpu the default; gpu recommended for Android flagships). A translation model, not open chat: one conversation per message with the card's prompt, 'Translate the following text into <language>. Note that you should **only output the translated result without any additional explanation**:' then an empty line and the text, as the user message (no system instruction). A second message in the same conversation fails (the template's else branch, LiteRT-LM #3166): measured on litert-lm-api 0.16.1 and 0.17.1 on a Mac CPU on 2026-10-19, and by the card on 0.17.1 and 0.18.0. The file is the 2026-10-06 GPU graph rewrite with the signature input param_tensor; on 2026-10-19 litert-lm-api 0.16.1 (the SDK's pin) and 0.17.1 translated the same ten sentences on a Mac CPU with greedy sampling, near-identical. runtime_range is the one version this file ran on that the SDK links (0.17.0 was not run; 0.17.1 is outside the SDK's pin). No device has run the gpu profile on 0.16.x: the card's GPU numbers come from LiteRT-LM main builds of 2026-09-18 and adac974b, so the default profile is cpu and gpu loads only when asked for.
